upsert.title: AI Builder Challenge 2026
upsert.summary: Free, fully online challenge to build something with AI; solo or teams of up to three. Winner announced mid-December 2026.
upsert.eligibility: Anyone worldwide aged 16 or older; individuals or teams of up to 3; free registration.

prize.description: EUR 1,000 cash to the winner, plus a EUR 1,000 donation to an educational institution of the winner's choice (not paid to the winner) and a 3D-printed award.

notes: Submission cutoff time and timezone are not stated on the official page.

upsert.title: Snapmaker Innovation Fund 2026: Open Competition Phase 2
upsert.summary: Open competition for projects built around the Snapmaker U1 3D printer. Phase 2 runs 28 Oct to 24 Dec 2026 with results due 14 Jan 2027.
upsert.eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide per the aggregator listing; owning a Snapmaker U1 is recommended but not required. Confirm age and country rules on the official page.

prize.description: US$50,000 cash for this phase, up to US$5,000 per project across about 20 projects (Phase 1 tiers were 3x$5,000, 7x$3,000, 10x$1,500; Phase 2 said to keep the same structure).

notes: Details taken from the DevGrants Daily detail page; the official page could not be opened in this run. Submission timezone not stated.

upsert.title: EasyEDA Spark 2026 Hardware Program
upsert.summary: Open-source hardware program: design in EasyEDA Pro, manufacture through JLC services and publish on OSHWLab. Registration closes 30 Nov, project submission 31 Dec 2026 (UTC+8); winners in Feb 2027.
upsert.eligibility: Aged 16 or older; students, makers, engineers, startups and educators worldwide. Projects must be designed in EasyEDA Pro, built via JLC services and published on OSHWLab.

prize.description: US$85,000 prize pool, top project up to US$30,000. Separate non-cash support: JLC covers up to 80% of eligible manufacturing costs, and a US$100 JLCPCB coupon for finished qualified projects.

notes: Details taken from the DevGrants Daily detail page; the official page could not be opened in this run. Registration closes earlier, on 30 Nov 2026 (UTC+8).

upsert.title: Decentralize AI Hackathon by HackerNoon (Round 2)
upsert.summary: Write-up based hackathon on open and decentralized AI infrastructure, run with Nosana, Arweave and MEXC. Round 2 covers Nov 2026 to Feb 2027; entries are HackerNoon posts.
upsert.eligibility: Developers, researchers and startups building open AI infrastructure; no country or team-size limits listed by the aggregator. Confirm on the official page.

prize.description: US$51,750 or more in cash shared by 15 winners, plus a US$450 pool for follow-up posts. Separately, the first 500 participants get US$70 in Nosana compute credits each (credits, not cash).

notes: Details taken from the DevGrants Daily detail page; the official page could not be opened in this run.

upsert.title: STM32Cube Innovation Challenge 2026: Design with STM32C5
upsert.summary: Online embedded design contest on Elektor Labs. Project ideas and free-board requests until 30 Nov 2026; final projects due 31 Jan 2027; winners announced 17 Mar 2027.
upsert.eligibility: Individuals aged 18 or older with a valid postal and email address; no teams or companies. No country limits stated. Elektor and ST staff excluded.

prize.description: EUR 5,000 in prizes: EUR 2,500 first, EUR 1,500 second, EUR 1,000 third. Limited free STM32C5 boards go to the best project ideas (not to all participants).

notes: Details taken from the DevGrants Daily detail page; the official page could not be opened in this run. Final deadline is 24:00 CET on 31 Jan 2027.
